integrity_statement: The exact parameter threshold and escape asymptotics are supported by an explicit analytical proof. Finite simulations corroborate but do not establish the universal conclusions.
mathematical_object: The entire-plane smooth two-map coupling with Gaussian-cubic odd local map, and parameter a>0.
scientific_limitations: No detailed classification of bounded attractors, periodic cycles, fractal basin boundaries or invariant measures.
Unbounded means divergent at infinite discrete time; finite-time singularities do not occur.
The result excludes nonpositive nonlinear amplitude; negative amplitude reverses the nonlinear tail sign.

title: Sharp global escape boundary and log-log critical clock for coupled Gaussian-cubic maps
